description.value: Ferraro Foods is a family-owned supermarket in Rossland that has operated since 1943, making it one of the oldest independent grocers in the Kootenays. The Rossland location carries a full-service Meat & Seafood Shoppe, Deli with Grab-n-Go meals and sandwiches, Cheese Shoppe, in-house bakery, and a broad produce and grocery selection. It is a well-stocked resupply point for touring cyclists moving through the Columbia and Kootenay region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and belongs to a two-location family grocery chain; the Rossland store is confirmed at 2029 Columbia Avenue with phone (250) 362-5206, matching OSM tags exactly. The About Us page confirms the Rossland location has a full-service Meat & Seafood Shoppe, Deli, Cheese Shoppe, and produce/grocery/dairy departments, supporting Basic groceries as true. No bike parking, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'Ferarro Foods' is a misspelling; the business's own website consistently uses 'Ferraro Foods' (double-r in Ferraro). OSM record should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible supermarket operating since 1943 with confirmed Rossland location details. Valuable resupply stop for touring cyclists.

Hot food.detail: Deli page confirms Grab-n-Go Meals, Sandwiches, Panini Sandwiches, and Soups available at the Rossland location
